tables.name: search_inference_job

indexes.path: a logical request belongs to one job (idempotent receipts)
a provider attempt belongs to one job (idempotent receipts)

checks.name: succeeded_has_result
checks.sql: "state" <> 4 OR ("result_ref" IS NOT NULL AND "outcome_hash" IS NOT NULL)

checks.name: unknown_no_completion
checks.sql: "state" <> 3 OR ("result_ref" IS NULL AND "completed_at" IS NULL)

tables.note: Built from the field table. Columns the model lists without '?' are NOT NULL, except four that cannot exist at admission and are nullable by lifecycle: provider_attempt_id (no attempt before dispatch), worker_version (observed), lease_holder and lease_expires_at (no lease while queued); the Search owner should confirm. Types: input_hash/source_set_hash/outcome_hash are hash; source_manifest_ref is the typed ResourceVersionRef (proto); result_ref/source_publication_ref and the Commerce identities (logical_request_id, provider_attempt_id, intent_receipt) are id; reason is the named reason (key); profile, workflow_id, outcome_receipt are text. The 120 second admission-to-result deadline is policy, not a check; reusing a job_id with a different input hash, source revocation cancelling queued jobs and the current-epoch lease rule are guarded-plan rules. outcome_hash is not unique (the model says only that it makes receipts idempotent).

tables.name: search_search_document
tables.model: 03 section 5 search.search_document (same shape as 03 section 2 search_document, scoped by workspace_id)

indexes.path: one document per canonical source aggregate within a workspace and product

tables.note: Cloud store: the local search_document shape scoped by workspace_id (and product_id, model 04 section 8). The local workspace_scope column is replaced by workspace_id. scope_key is the single alphanumeric FTS token of workspace and product used as the mandatory scope predicate of every query (model 04 section 8); it is not a model field. Permission is applied at query time and is not stored (SI-03).

tables.name: search_retrieval_chunk
tables.model: 03 section 5 search.retrieval_chunk (same shape as 03 section 3 retrieval_chunk, scoped by workspace_id)

indexes.path: incremental invalidation of the chunks of a changed source

tables.note: There is no embedding column in D1: the 1024-dimension vectors live in Vectorize (model 04 section 8), keyed by chunk_id with workspace namespace and realm/product metadata. embedding_model_id is the staleness key. The model's invalidation index includes source_version; this index is (source_kind, source_id) as assigned, and source_version stays a stored column. No search_anchor table is built in the cloud.
